what.text: This page follows people displaced by disasters inside Vietnam, as counted by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 15267 people still displaced by disasters; IDMC reports this year-end figure only for some years.
Refugees from Vietnam, a separate group, live mostly in France, the United Kingdom and Germany.

why.text: Floods, mass movements and storms are among the disasters recorded for Vietnam in IDMC's data.
The fact pack records no conflict-related displacement inside the country.

when.text: IDMC's year-end figure rose from 7206 in 2019 to 161812 in 2020, the main year of displacement in the data.
It was lower in the following years.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living.
IDMC also counts new displacements from disasters, which count movements, not people, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
